findings.detail: Stored distribution_rate is 22.411557%, but the source financial highlights support about 8.001584% from 4.04 distributions per unit divided by 50.49 beginning NAV per unit.

rationale: F16 fired because the stored distribution_rate value 22.411557 exceeded the income-yield heuristic. Raw financial highlights show 2025 total distributions of 4.04 per unit and beginning NAV of 50.49 per unit, implying a distribution rate of 8.001584%, not 22.411557%. The same table gives the 2025 ratio of net investment income to average net assets as 17.72%, so the rule threshold is 26.58% and the source-supported distribution rate does not violate it. The defect is the stored distribution_rate, not the filer source.
